title.en: Starting Life in Another World from Zero

If it weren't Reinhard-san, this would be an incident.
Behind-the-scenes detail: regarding the insignia, when Felt and Emilia are holding it, the gem in the center is...
A protagonist who moves on to Chapter 2 while still asleep.
Yes, it's Re: Life in a Different World from Zero!
Isn't it super fast?
Behind the scenes: the sponsor card is the director's playground! Not me!
Well then, thank you again this week for joining us for Re: Life in a Different World from Zero. As you can tell if you watched episode 3, it moved like crazy. It was insane.

But the director and staff were saying things like, "We couldn't really make episodes 1 and 2 move that much because we wanted to focus our effort on episode 3..." and honestly I have no idea what they're talking about. I have no idea what they're talking about, so episode 3 moved so much it was absurd. All I can say is thank you.

Whether you can really call it getting through safely with the protagonist's stomach split open is questionable, but Chapter 1 has ended. Next is Chapter 2. That character you've all been waiting for will appear too, so look forward to it, everyone!
Thanks again for this week, and please join us again next week! Next time, look forward to "Clown Makeup Supremacy"!
